newsitem.title: USA: CME CATTLE AND PORK COMPLEX PRE-OPENING CALLS.
newsitem.headline: CME CATTLE AND PORK COMPLEX PRE-OPENING CALLS.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Live seen near steady but boxed beef market still on defensive.
FEEDER CATTLE - Off 0.500 to 1.000 cent. Carryover from Tuesday's limit down market and corn futures surge.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Steady to lower live calls and pork product prices down further.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to off 0.250 cent. Out-of-town neutral and deliveries in strong hands but continued weakness in cash bellies bearish.
